newsitem.title: USA: Party City files for 2.24 mln common shrs.
newsitem.headline: Party City files for 2.24 mln common shrs.

text.p: Party City Corp filed Thursday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to 2,240,000 common shares.

Of the total 1,200,000 common will be sold by the company and 1,040,000 common will be offered by certain stockholders, including the company's chairman, the filing said. After the offering, outstanding shares will total 8,174,000 common.

Selling stockholders include Steven Mandall, chairman of the board and president of the company with a 400,000 common offering and Perry Kaplan, former executive vice president with 400,000 common for sale.

The stockholders have granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to buy up to 336,000 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Smith Barney Inc, Tucker Anthony Inc and Morgan Keegan & Co Inc.

Net proceeds will be used to open new company-owned Super Stores, to acquire existing franchise-owned stores and to provide for working capital and other general corporate purposes, the company said in the filing.
Party City, based in Rockaway, New Jersey, is a rapidly growing specialty retailer of party supplies through its network of discount Super Stores.
